shared_elements: tall vertical rectangular stone slab/panel as the field
carved relief imagery organized in horizontal registers/rows
repeated animal or creature motifs (bird-like/quadruped heads in profile)
a horizontal band of repeated pattern near the top
imagery arranged in vertical columnar sequence
justification: Both are tall, narrow vertical slabs whose carved content is stacked into horizontal registers, and both include repeated animal-head profiles and small round elements, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. The left is a fine-line drawing of dense, rectangular, tightly gridded compound glyph blocks in strict paired columns, while the right is a photograph of sparse, low-relief, rounded naturalistic animal figures spread over open stone surface — utterly different manner of rendering and density.
